title: On Convincing the elders at the third meeting
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：convince　|　正文 356 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 convince 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the farmer ① convinced the elders at the third meeting twice over, and every child in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three autumns on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the farmer ② convinces the elders at the third meeting year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ convince the elders at the third meeting at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ convinced the elders at the third meeting before — a line in the almanac for September 1981 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Convincing the elders at the third meeting twice over, the farmer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ convince everybody that the plan was safe year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Convince everybody that the plan was safe at once and never mention it again.

By 1994 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the almanac, and a new child from the next field ⑧ convinces everybody that the plan was safe twice over every autumn without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the fence, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ convinced the elders at the third meeting again when nobody else would.

⑩ To convince the elders at the third meeting, my mother said in 1999, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody convinces the elders at the third meeting year after year again and somebody must convince the elders at the third meeting twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 说服（一般过去式 convinced the elders at the third meeting：1987 年农人头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 说服（一般现在 convinces the elders at the third meeting：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 说服（不定式 to convince the elders at the third meeting：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 说服（过去完成时 had convinced the elders at the third meeting：1981 年九月的农事历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 说服（动名词 convincing the elders at the third meeting 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 使相信（convince everybody that the plan was safe：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去使相信让大家相信那方案稳妥）
G. v. 使相信（convince everybody that the plan was safe：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 说服（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 convinces everybody that the plan was safe，而母亲又一次 convinced the elders at the third meeting）

answers.why: convince 意为“说服”，1987 年农人来回两遍说服在第三次会上说服了长辈，那是田垄里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 convinced。
convince 意为“说服”，自那以后农人年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 convinces。
convince 意为“说服”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯说服在第三次会上说服了长辈”，此处为不定式 to convince the elders at the third meeting。
convince 意为“说服”，农事历里 九月 那行字说明早在 1994 年之前就有人说服过，故用过去完成时 had convinced。
convince 意为“说服”，农人说“说服在第三次会上说服了长辈这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 convincing the elders at the third meeting 作主语。
convince 意为“使相信”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去使相信让大家相信那方案稳妥”，should ever 之后用原形 convince everybody that the plan was safe。
convince 意为“使相信”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻使相信让大家相信那方案稳妥（convince everybody that the plan was safe at once），以后再也不要提起。
convince 意为“说服”，新来的孩子每个秋天都照例使相信让大家相信那方案稳妥，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 convinces。
convince 意为“说服”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍说服在第三次会上说服了长辈，用一般过去式 convinced 叙述。
convince 意为“说服”，结尾那句是母亲 1999 年的话：要说服在第三次会上说服了长辈，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和田垄记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 convince 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the farmer convinced the elders at the third meeting twice over, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the farmer convinces the elders at the third meeting year after year whenever the field asks.
Convincing the elders at the third meeting twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever convince everybody that the plan was safe year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next field convinces everybody that the plan was safe twice over every autumn, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother convinced the elders at the third meeting again, and the field remembered that half.
